entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-02-19
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • "Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.ResxSourceGenerator" should work for .resw files too #82466
  • Release a new NuGet for "Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.ResxSourceGenerator", the current is from June 2025 ... #82465
  • Assertions in nullable walker when opening Roslyn's LanguageParser.cs #82464
  • CSC task -- command line exceeds Windows limit #82455

PullRequests

Created

  • Extensions: fix crash with targeted attribute on extension block #82463
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything
  • Reduce allocations during source text diffing #82462
    Area-IDE
  • Rename HasUnionAttribute property #82461
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unions
  • Tighten fuzzy edit-distance threshold for length-5 patterns #82459
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode
  • Separate fuzzy pattern matching into dedicated FuzzyPatternMatcher #82458
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode
  • Improve nav-to fuzzy pre-filtering with q-gram bigram bitset and corrected length thresholds #82457
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode
  • Unsafe evolution: warn for using the attribute under legacy rules and some cleanup #82456
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Extension indexers: indexing with implicit indexers #82453
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, VSCode, Feature - Extension Indexers
  • Add support for SHA-384 and SHA-512 hash algorithms #82452
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review
  • add glossary of lsp terms #82451
    Area-IDE
  • Run the Linux Single Machine CI with the Spanish locale. #82450
    Area-Infrastructure

Merged

  • Centralize LanguageServer exit codes #82415
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Merge latest bits from `main` into `features/extensions` #82460
    Area-Compilers
  • Fix unguarded access to state in VisualStudioWorkspaceImpl #82454
    Area-IDE, Next
  • Unsafe evolution: use attribute to denote requires-unsafe members #82383
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Remove `IQueueItem` abstraction and standardize CLSP queue pipeline on `QueueItem` #82410
    Area-Infrastructure, VSCode, Next

Updated

  • Migrate the old workspace logging tool into Roslyn itself #82407
    Area-IDE
  • Improve navigate-to filtering to avoid scanning documents unnecessarily. #82431
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode
  • Parallelize loading solution-level analyzers #82447
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Misc. Union changes #82448
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unions
  • Update MicrosoftNETTestSdkVersion to 17.14.1 #82446
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Avoid duplicate error with ambiguous user-defined conversion #82395
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Fix unsafe context when binding multiple static usings #82427
    Area-Compilers
  • Avoid unnecessary defensive copy for constrained calls on readonly struct receivers #82432
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Avoid eliding nested pointer-to-ref conversions #82263
    Area-Compilers
  • Fix Generate Type to respect existing file namespace #82167
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode
  • Fix exception in `ExtractMethod` with `var` pattern in compound pattern #82171
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode
  • LSP 3.18 protocol updates #82294
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • File-based apps: csproj-in-cone check #82327
    Area-Infrastructure, VSCode
